svg.title: Lookout architecture
svg.desc: Human edits and approvals persist in the workspace. An optional polling watcher wakes the external personal agent, which resumes through scoped MCP reads. Workspace capabilities are logical modules.
svg.text: Logical capabilities, not separate services. Optional wake requires an agent-host integration.
